title: 日常口语与会话短语
html:
日常口语与会话短语

概述

日常口语短语（Spoken Phrases）是英语口语交际的"胶水"。这些短语在对话中频繁出现，掌握它们能让你的英语更自然、更流利。本文按功能分类整理高频口语表达，每组提供搭配、对话示例和写作替代。

打招呼与寒暄 (Greetings & Small Talk)

短语 含义 语域 搭配/用法
How's it going? 最近怎么样？ 非正式 回答：Not bad. / Pretty good.
What's up? 怎么了？/你好 非正式 回答：Not much. / Hey!
Long time no see! 好久不见！ 非正式 久别重逢时使用
How have you been? 你最近好吗？ 中性 回答：I've been great, thanks.
Good to see you. 很高兴见到你 中性 见面时使用
How do you do? 你好（正式） 正式 回答：How do you do?
It's a pleasure to meet you. 很荣幸认识你 正式 首次见面
What have you been up to? 你最近在忙什么？ 非正式 用于老朋友之间

听说例句

A: Hey, long time no see! How have you been?
B: I've been good! Just got back from a trip. What about you?
A: Not bad. Been pretty busy with work. What have you been up to?
B: I started a new project last month. It's keeping me on my toes.
A: Sounds exciting! We should catch up over coffee sometime.
B: Definitely! Let's set something up this week.

写作替代

口语 写作替代
How's it going? I hope this message finds you well.
What's up? I am writing to inquire about...
Long time no see! It has been a while since we last spoke.

同意与不同意 (Agreeing & Disagreeing)

短语 含义 语气强度
Absolutely! 完全同意！ 强烈同意
Exactly! 正是如此！ 强烈同意
That makes sense. 有道理。 一般同意
I see your point. 我理解你的观点。 部分同意
I'm not so sure about that. 我不太确定。 委婉不同意
I beg to differ. 恕我不能同意。 正式不同意
That's not quite right. 那不太对。 直接不同意
I see it differently. 我有不同看法。 中性不同意
Fair point, but... 有道理，但是… 让步+反驳
I couldn't agree more. 我完全同意。 强烈同意

听说例句

A: I think we should postpone the launch by two weeks.
B: That makes sense. The QA team needs more time.
C: I see your point, but our competitors are launching next week.
A: Fair point, but shipping a buggy product is worse.
C: I beg to differ — we can release an MVP and iterate.
B: I couldn't agree more with that approach, actually.

请求与帮助 (Requesting & Offering Help)

短语 含义 语域
Could you do me a favor? 你能帮我个忙吗？ 中性
Would you mind...? 你介意…吗？ 礼貌
I was wondering if you could... 不知道你能不能… 委婉
Do you need a hand? 需要帮忙吗？ 非正式
Let me give you a hand. 我来帮你。 非正式
I'd appreciate it if you could... 如果你能…我会很感激 正式
Is there anything I can help with? 有什么我能帮的吗？ 中性
No worries, I've got it. 没事，我来搞定。 非正式

听说例句

A: Could you do me a favor? I need someone to review this document.
B: Sure, no problem. When do you need it by?
A: End of day, if possible. I'd really appreciate it.
B: I've got it. I'll send you my feedback by 5 PM.
A: You're a lifesaver! Is there anything I can help with in return?
B: Actually, do you need a hand with the presentation tomorrow?

表达感受 (Expressing Feelings)

短语 含义 场景
I'm over the moon! 我太高兴了！ 极度开心
I'm on cloud nine. 我开心极了。 非常幸福
I'm fed up with... 我受够了… 厌烦
I'm stressed out. 我压力很大。 压力
I'm under the weather. 我身体不舒服。 生病
That's a relief! 那太好了！松了口气 释然
I'm on the fence about it. 我还在犹豫。 犹豫不决
It gets on my nerves. 这让我很烦。 恼怒
I'm looking forward to it. 我很期待。 期待
That really made my day. 那真让我开心。 惊喜

听说例句

A: How are you feeling about the promotion?
B: I'm over the moon! I've been working toward this for two years.
A: You deserve it! How about the new project?
B: I'm on the fence about it. The timeline is really tight.
A: I get it. I'm stressed out about the deadline too.
B: Let's grab lunch — that'll be a nice relief from all the pressure.

日常动作与习惯 (Daily Actions & Routines)

短语 含义 搭配
sleep in 睡懒觉 sleep in on weekends
work out 锻炼 work out at the gym
eat out 外出就餐 eat out at a restaurant
hang out 闲逛、聚一聚 hang out with friends
catch up 叙旧/赶上 catch up with old friends
wind down 放松下来 wind down after work
run errands 办杂事 run some errands
do the dishes 洗碗 do the dishes after dinner
take a nap 打个盹 take a quick nap
binge-watch 刷剧 binge-watch a series

听说例句

A: What did you do over the weekend?
B: I slept in on Saturday, then hung out with some friends.
A: Nice! I had to run errands most of the day.
B: On Sunday I worked out in the morning and then binge-watched a new series.
A: I should wind down more on weekends. I've been so stressed lately.
B: We should catch up over dinner soon. Let's eat out somewhere new.

道别与结束对话 (Saying Goodbye)

短语 含义 语域
Take care! 保重！ 中性
See you around. 回头见。 非正式
Catch you later. 回头聊。 非正式
It was great talking to you. 和你聊天很愉快。 中性
Let's keep in touch. 保持联系。 中性
Have a good one! 祝你愉快！ 非正式
I'd better get going. 我得走了。 委婉告别
I look forward to seeing you again. 期待再见。 正式

听说例句

A: Well, I'd better get going. I have an early meeting tomorrow.
B: Of course! It was great talking to you.
A: Same here. Let's keep in touch!
B: Definitely. Catch you later!
A: Take care! Have a good one!

写作替代

口语 写作替代
See you around. I look forward to our next meeting.
Catch you later. Thank you for your time.
Take care! Best regards, / Warm regards,
